```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(lavaan)
library(lavaanPlot)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
hr <- read_csv('./kaggle_hr_analytics.csv') %>% 
  mutate(salary = case_when(salary == "low" ~ 1,
                            salary == "medium" ~ 2,
                            salary == "high" ~ 3)) %>% 
  rename(department =  sales) %>% 
  mutate(department = fct_infreq(department)) %>% 
  mutate(number_project2 = number_project^2)
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
m <- '
satisfaction_level ~ sl_np * number_project + sl_np2 * number_project2 + sl_le * last_evaluation
number_project ~ np_le * last_evaluation
number_project2 ~ np2_le * last_evaluation
last_eval_sat_level := (sl_np * np_le) + (sl_np2 * np2_le)
'

f <- sem(m, data = hr)

summary(f)

lavaanPlot(model = f, coefs = T, stars = T)

```
